pages.text: $(italic)A mobile glass cannon with maximum ranged damage and paper-thin defenses. Don't get hit.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -20%  |  Equipment HP: $(bold)Halved$() (glass cannon)$(br)$(bold)Armor Penalty:$() -15% armor (final value)

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Swift$(): +15% movement speed, the fastest class. With +10% attack speed on top, the $(thing)Ranger$() is built for kiting and repositioning.$(br2)$(bold)Eagle Eye$(): +20% projectile damage for arrows and thrown weapons.$(br2)$(bold)Glass Cannon$(): equipment HP (Vitality enchant, HP affixes, armor attributes) is halved; base HP, Spice of Life food HP and level-up HP are not.

pages.title: Risk and Reward
pages.text: The $(thing)Ranger$() has the highest ranged DPS in the game but dies in 2-3 hits from endgame content. Positioning is everything.

pages.title: Risk and Reward, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Elf$(): +10% speed stacks with Swift for extreme mobility, and night vision keeps you safer in dungeons.$(br)$(thing)Halfling$(): a smaller hitbox and food efficiency for sustained kiting.$(br)$(thing)Human$(): no weaknesses, and +15% XP to reach glass cannon safety thresholds faster.$(br2)$(bold)Next: spec the Marksman tree ($(k:puffish_skills.open)) for ranged damage.$()
